paper.title: Another Visit With Standard and Modified Givens Transformations and A Remark On Algorithm 539 (Algorithm 830)
paper.venue: ACM TOMS 30(1), March 2004, pp. 86-94 (ACM article not read)

field: numerics (dense linear algebra: modified Givens rotations)

claim.text: The first element of the scaled x-vector in the first test of the shipped reference output res1 (rotm_battery.f90 on data3): 14.519450 (E16.8 print), compared with tolerance 1e-5 absolute.

reference.archive: netlib.org/toms/830.gz sha256 aadb021e657f625267c8aa6e4b9f4b5b83aed15a5b7755e8339798e8704925a6 (member Fortran90/Drivers/res1, copied into evidence/ by the recipe; first test x-vector element 0.14519450E+02)

attempt: The authors' Makefile as shipped uses F90 = /opt/NAGWare/bin/f95, which does not exist in the sandbox (make: /opt/NAGWare/bin/f95: No such file or directory). Build-only workaround: a directory of symlinks to the unedited archive (Fortran90/Src, Drivers/Makefile, Drivers/rotm_battery.f90, Drivers/data3); then the Makefile's own target res1 with F90=gfortran, F90OPTS=-O2, F90LINK=gfortran, F90LINKOPTS=-O2 on the command line. No source byte is edited. The full output res1 is byte-identical to the shipped res1 (diff: 0 lines, all 12 values of the first test block).

original_attempt.reason: make: /opt/NAGWare/bin/f95: No such file or directory (NAG compiler named in the shipped Makefile is absent)

diagnostics.precision: Printed value has 8 significant digits (E16.8). The compared value is 14.51945 as parsed from the output; tolerance 1e-5 absorbs print rounding (5e-7 absolute at this magnitude).

environment.flags: -O2 (command-line override of the Makefile's NAG flags)

build_commands: cd /work/build/Fortran90/Drivers && export PATH=/work/env16/bin:$PATH && timeout 600 make F90=gfortran "F90OPTS=-O2" F90LINK=gfortran "F90LINKOPTS=-O2" res1; echo "make exit=$?"
